access_boundary: This record represents the Muse Spark 1.3 checkpoint announced September 2, 2026 and served under the Meta Model API. The 1.1 and 1.2 checkpoints, the contributor tier, Muse Code, and reseller surfaces remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Dated named checkpoint with announcement, reasoning capabilities, and documented token efficiency
Meta documents the checkpoint identity and tier placement in its API terms
tradeoffs: No model weights are published, so the release cannot be self-operated
Preview terms are replaceable at Meta's discretion and no retirement policy is published

source_metadata.name: Muse Spark 1.3
source_metadata.description: Muse Spark 1.3 is a multimodal reasoning model from Meta for long-running agentic, multi-agent, and coding workflows. It improves long-horizon agent collaboration, instruction following, and coding efficiency relative to Muse Spark 1.2.
